prompt: Make a record implement an interface: LedgerEntry must supply summary() and severity() so the interface's inherited banner() default method works. Complete the record, then run the tests.
explanation: A record cannot extend a class, but it can implement any number of interfaces, and its body is the place to put the required methods. Because banner() is a default method, the record inherits working behaviour for free as soon as summary() and severity() are correct. Pinning java.util.Locale.US on String.format keeps the decimal point a dot on every machine, which matters for money strings.
hints: Add the two @Override methods to the record body; the components user, action and amountCents are readable directly by name.
String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "$%.2f", amountCents / 100.0) gives the dollars-and-cents text -- note the / 100.0 so the division is not integer division.
severity() is a plain chain of ifs on amountCents; check the largest threshold first, and never write banner() yourself.
